title: Manyhands JSON v1 progress event
description: One step of a request's progress, as the request's sink is sent it. It names the request and where it works, and holds nothing of what the request carries or meets: no body or source, no commit message, no remote location, no credential and no text a server sent. stage is what the request is about to do. accepted is the request recorded, before anything is done for it; writing and indexing are what a local command then does. The rest are a synchronization's: connecting before it opens a connection, fetching before it fetches, observing while it compares what it has with what the remote holds, updating_local before it moves a local branch, pushing before it pushes, verifying once the push has returned and before the remote is asked what it now holds, and indexing once that is known. stopping is a cancellation the request has seen and is about to honor. effects is what the request has completed so far. Every event of a call is sent before the call returns its result, and the result is what a caller acts on.

operation_id.description: Null for a request that has no operation.
